lemmas.name: trip15
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : increasingTriplet_precond nums), increasingTriplet_postcond nums (let nums' := nums.zipIdx; nums'.any (fun (x, i) => nums'.any (fun (y, j) => nums'.any (fun (z, k) => decide (i < j ∧ j < k ∧ x < y ∧ y < z))))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold increasingTriplet_postcond
  intro nums'
  refine ⟨fun hr => hr, fun hn => ?_⟩
  have hn' : (nums'.any (fun (x, i) => nums'.any (fun (y, j) => nums'.any (fun (z, k) => decide (i < j ∧ j < k ∧ x < y ∧ y < z))))) ≠ true := hn
  simp only [ne_eq, List.all_eq_true, List.any_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hn' ⊢
  rintro ⟨x, i⟩ hx ⟨y, j⟩ hy ⟨z, k⟩ hz
  by_contra hc
  apply hn'
  exact ⟨(x, i), hx, (y, j), hy, (z, k), hz, by omega⟩
